message: 愛憎姉妹

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san. How about we go with something like this here, and leave it like that?」

name: Helena
message: 「Right. I suppose we could do this like so, and then do that」

name: Ria
message: 「Those two sure look like they're getting along~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh!! Ah!! Yes!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you hear what we were just talking about?」

name: Ria
message: 「Uh, yeah! Of course, of course...... wait」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm sorry. That was a lie」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong today? You've been spacing out for a while now......」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, y...... you think so, ahahaha......\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Could it be...... you're feeling sick somewhere!?」

name: Ria
message: 「No, I'm fine! See, I'm full of energy\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure......?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm totally fine」
Despite saying that, she isn't puffing out her chest like she usually does. Not that I'd know where to look even if she did.

name: Helena
message: 「That's no good. Spacing out when we're having an important discussion」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah. Sorry」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway. First, using this method――」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmph~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san, is something the matter?」

name: Helena
message: 「No. It's nothing at all. M-o-r-e i-m-p-o-r-t-a-n-t-l-y\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh」
Helena presses herself right up against my back.

name: Helena
message: 「Hey. Just because you're in the chairwoman's office doesn't mean you have to be so tense.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, no... I'm not really tense or anything--」

name: Helena
message: 「Is that so? For someone who isn't, look... you're this stiff.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yikes!! W-Where are you touching?!」

name: Helena
message: 「You want me to say where out loud? You're quite mean despite your innocent looks, aren't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sis...」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, face this way. I'll cast a little charm to calm your heart.」

name: Synn
message: 「*Squeeze*」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez... you're not relaxing at all. You're only getting harder and harder.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's...」

name: Helena
message: 「Mfufu\s04 I like an obedient boy\s04 So, I'll give you this♪」
I-In all the confusion, I somehow ended up receiving a bizarre trophy...

name: Ria
message: 「Hold on, Sis!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Helena
message: 「What is it, Ria? It's rare for you to raise your voice like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「You're teasing Synn-kun like that again--!」

name: Helena
message: 「It might look that way, but it's just how I express my affection, so it can't be helped, right? Look, I always do it to you too, don't I?」

name: Ria
message: 「M-Maybe so, but」

name: Helena
message: 「Synn-chan, you're the type who looks slimmer with clothes on, aren't you? You might actually be amazing once you strip.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha―?! No way―」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu\s04 One button, two buttons...」

name: Ria
message: 「T-H-A-T-'S E-N-O-U-G-H!!」
Ria-senpai forcefully stepped between us and blocked Helena.

name: Helena
message: 「Ugh, what's the big deal? We were just getting to the good part, so don't interrupt us~」

name: Ria
message: 「Can't you see you're making Synn-kun uncomfortable?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, really? For all you know, he might actually be enjoying it」

name: Helena
message: 「I mean, getting his rock-hard spot nice and gently massaged... makes him happy, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez! Big Sis, you're unbelievable!」

name: Helena
message: 「His shoulders, that is♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, my~? Where did Ria think I meant~? Could it be...」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I don't know!」

name: Helena
message: 「So your chest isn't the only thing about you that's mature for your age~. Your big sister is so relieved\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez!! Anyway, I won't forgive you if you keep playing around with Synn-kun like a toy!」

name: Helena
message: 「What are you talking about? Synn-chan doesn't belong to you, you know」

name: Ria
message: 「He doesn't belong to you either, Big Sis!」

name: Helena
message: 「That's not true, right~~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no... well, that's, um...」

name: Ria
message: 「If you corner him like that, he has no choice but to nod!! You do that on purpose knowing full well how he'll react!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, stop it. Even I wouldn't force him. Besides, if Synn-chan is feeling good, what's the harm? Right\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「F-Feeling good... I said no more of this!!\s09」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't butt in, kid!」

name: Synn
message: 「N―Now, you two, that's enough fighting―」

name: Helena & Ria
message: 「Be quiet for a second!!」
Just what on earth is going on here...!?
